text: {"lessons":["A single month’s account change does not tell me whether a trade was wise; I should focus on a steady, risk-conscious plan.","Selling the same number of shares across stocks ignored their different prices, gains, and risks; I should make decisions stock by stock and consider the overall portfolio.","I have traded infrequently so far, which suits my preference to avoid large swings; I should not sell winners or losers automatically, but weigh each holding against my long-term needs."]}
